name: shivaay-luxury-estate-platform
description: Ultra-luxury real estate platform with scroll-driven canvas background sequence, Next.js frontend, and Nest.js backend API.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "magenta,cyan" "npm --prefix backend run start:dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
